prompts.name: The Lantern Table
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished, exceptionally polished native PC card-game MAIN MENU concept screenshot, landscape 16:9 at 2560x1440. Game: Legend of the Five Rings, Emperor Edition, Japanese-inspired fantasy collectible card game. This is an approval concept for a real Godot game, not a website. Direction A: THE LANTERN TABLE. Establish the feeling of arriving at a quiet Japanese tavern and sitting down to play. Rich cinematic painterly realism, highly convincing aged physical materials, exquisite restraint.
Composition: camera slightly above seated eye level looking diagonally across an intimate walnut gaming table toward shadowy shoji screens; a large midnight NAVY blue woven mat occupies the foreground/right with subtle rubbed gold cloud embroidery, two neatly squared weathered card decks in black and deep green with understated five-circle gold motifs, softly lit paper lantern completely visible at far right. No game in progress, no spread of playing cards. Amber light spills across navy cloth and worn dark wood; slight atmospheric haze and soft depth, no characters. The room goes naturally dark on the left, reserving generous uncluttered space for a readable title and live-menu-style text without a large rectangular panel.
Type and menu overlay: in the upper-left quarter title in restrained aged ivory Japanese-influenced brush lettering, exact readable English text "LEGEND OF THE" on small first line, "FIVE RINGS" large on second; small widely tracked aged-gold subtitle "EMPEROR EDITION". Below title vertically align five options, with plenty of breathing space and excellent readability at desktop scale, exact text: "Play", "Private Match", "Card Library", "Options", "Quit". Menu headings have convincing expressive brush-font strokes, not generic sans serif. Play is selected: a subtle worn brass short line and SOFT diffuse amber glow behind the text, no hard bright box; the other entries warm ivory. Title/menu together take ~left third, environmental tableau is right two-thirds, safe margins around every element. Tiny unintrusive "0.3.10" bottom-left. No additional text, no fake Japanese writing, no HUD, no modern cards/pills/dashboard/web navigation. Highest quality production-game art: composition, textured light, tactile shadows, fully formed straight lantern geometry. Menu letters crisp and undistorted, separate from the scene's perspective.

prompts.name: The Imperial Screen
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished premium native PC card-game MAIN MENU concept screenshot, 16:9 landscape 2560x1440. Exact game Legend of the Five Rings, Emperor Edition. Direction B: THE IMPERIAL SCREEN. A striking Japanese folding-screen painting becomes the title-screen environment: dramatic worn gold-leaf and black ink brushwork, large elegant white crane on right amid dark pine branches, a powerful gold lion painted lower right, both clearly painted motifs on an antique byobu screen rather than living animals. Rich midnight navy, sooty black, muted antique brass; ivory highlights; gold areas softly illuminated, never bright yellow. Foreground bottom edge includes a narrow dark walnut ledge and a small paper lantern fully inside frame, casting warm spill up the lacquer and across the screen. Render painted silk and aged gold-leaf with beautiful tactile detail and a cinematic shallow angled perspective. Large composition sweeping from lower right to upper right. No people, no crowded decorative props.
The left 38 percent of the image naturally transitions into shadowed navy-black lacquer/ink, for title and live menu overlay. Upper left exact title "LEGEND OF THE" small then "FIVE RINGS" very large in graceful hand-painted English brush lettering with dry textured strokes, antique ivory, and smaller subtitle "EMPEROR EDITION" in faded brass. Below, five readable vertical menu entries with excellent rhythm, exact text "Play", "Private Match", "Card Library", "Options", "Quit". Use elegant brush-style heading letters. Play has a slim soft amber stroke and diffused warm halo behind text; no sharp modern box. Others are aged ivory. Generous safe margins and rich readable contrast. Small "0.3.10" bottom left, no other writing. This should be a believable shipping GAME title screen with clear interactions, not cover art, website or flat vector design. A mature collectible card game's atmosphere, sparse functionality, exceptionally striking composition. Do not add glowing neon, symbols pretending to be Japanese text, stats, portraits, cards in play, interface panels, or metallic fantasy swords. Crisp flat UI letterforms independent of backdrop perspective.

prompts.name: The Moonlit Study
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE finished high-budget native PC collectible-card-game MAIN MENU concept screenshot, 16:9 landscape 2560x1440. Legend of the Five Rings, Emperor Edition. Direction C: THE MOONLIT STUDY. Cinematic painted realism: a secluded Japanese castle study at night, camera at a seated angle across a navy-cloth-covered walnut desk, with open shoji to the right revealing layered temple rooftops, misty mountains and a luminous moon through sparse drifting cloud. Deep ink blue night, aged ivory and brass accents, warm amber lantern indoors balanced with cool moonlight outside. A complete, geometrically straight paper lantern stands on the right side of the desk in the foreground, both base and top in frame; a pair of neatly stacked black and green card decks with tasteful worn gold five-circle motifs rests nearby, no match in progress. Fine natural wood, subtle fabric weave, delicate ink landscapes on a distant wall. Beautiful atmospheric depth but a composed quiet image. No characters, combat, weapons, or clutter.
Main menu composition: left side is calm deep dark interior with a softly lit title at top left and menu below, taking ~35 percent of width, right side cinematic scene ~65 percent. Exact title in exquisite aged-ivory dry-brush English lettering "LEGEND OF THE" small, "FIVE RINGS" large; understated aged-gold subtitle "EMPEROR EDITION". Five vertically stacked options, large readable English brush heading font, exact text "Play", "Private Match", "Card Library", "Options", "Quit". The selected "Play" gets a soft warm brushline and subtle amber diffuse glow, no rectangular bounding box. Other entries clear warm ivory. Tiny "0.3.10" bottom-left, no extra copy. Menu/title are flat readable overlays, not perspective-distorted text on furniture. Comfortable safe margins, excellent legibility, confident typography. This is a real-game UI vision, not a website, promotional poster, vector mockup or dashboard. Render with tactile painterly sophistication and physically plausible lighting, detail consistent with aged navy gaming mat and Japanese tavern materials.
